HediffDef.label: flower god sigil: red apricot
HediffDef.description: A spring resonance passive. The red apricot flower god protects Qinghe, periodically healing the most severe wound, including permanent injuries.

HediffDef.label: flower god sigil: lotus
HediffDef.description: A summer resonance passive placeholder for dodge, disease, toxin, and pollution immunity hooks. Its full effect has not been implemented yet.

HediffDef.label: flower god sigil: magnolia
HediffDef.description: An autumn resonance passive placeholder for psychic invisibility, psychic sensitivity, and entropy loss hooks. Its full effect has not been implemented yet.

HediffDef.label: flower god sigil: red plum
HediffDef.description: A winter resonance passive placeholder for cold tolerance and freeze accumulation hooks. Its full effect has not been implemented yet.
